# Markdown to SPIP

> Convertisseur en ligne Markdown vers syntaxe SPIP, en temps réel

## Purpose

This web application converts Markdown syntax to SPIP syntax in real-time. It's designed for SPIP CMS users who want to write in Markdown and convert it to SPIP's native format.

## Key Features

- Real-time conversion (no submit button required)
- Split-view interface: Markdown input on left, SPIP output on right
- One-click copy to clipboard
- No data storage (RGPD-compliant)
- No tracking, no analytics
- Fully responsive (mobile/desktop)

## Supported Conversions

- Headings: `# Title` → `{{{Title}}}`
- Bold: `**text**` → `{{text}}`
- Italic: `*text*` → `{text}`
- Links: `[text](url)` → `[text->url]`
- Lists: `- item` → `-* item`
- Blockquotes: `> quote` → `<quote>quote</quote>`

## Technical Stack

- Backend: Laravel 12
- Frontend: Livewire 3 (real-time interactivity)
- Styling: TailwindCSS
- JS: Alpine.js (minimal)
- Language: PHP 8.3
- Build: Vite

## Architecture

- Single-page application using Livewire
- Stateless converter (no database)
- All conversion logic in `App\Support\MarkdownToSpipConverter`
- Real-time updates via Livewire wire:model.live
- Text is transmitted to server for conversion but never stored

## Installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/your-user/md2spip.git
composer install
npm install
cp .env.example .env
php artisan key:generate
npm run build
php artisan serve
```

## Testing

25 automated tests covering:
- Unit tests for conversion logic
- Feature tests for Livewire component
- Integration tests for pages

Run with: `php artisan test`

## Privacy

- No user tracking
- No analytics
- No data storage
- Online version: text sent to server for conversion but not stored
- Local version: everything stays on your machine
